module: MCP vehicle input tools: inject a control event (steering, throttle, brake…), test a "hydro" control round trip with error detection in the log, and run Lua in the VM of one or all vehicles.
notes: run_lua_vehicle is asynchronous: it returns the results of the PREVIOUS call (JSON vehId -> result) and launches the new one; call again to get the latest. The code is compiled with loadstring in the vehicle VM, errors caught by pcall.
test_hydro chains input.event(event, 1) -> (0.6 s) -> -1 -> (0.6 s) -> 0 -> (0.3 s) then scans beamng.log for "|E|" lines; result in shared.asyncResults.hydro, returned on the next call.
Security warning: run_lua_vehicle runs arbitrary code in the vehicle VMs.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: advances the test_hydro sequence (timed steps 1 to 3) and, at the end, reads the errors from the log.

inject_input.desc: Sends input.event(event, value, filter) into the vehicle's VM via be:queueObjectLua.

args.desc: {event: string (steering, throttle, brake, parkingbrake, clutch…), value?: number (default 0, typ. -1..1 or 0..1), filter?: integer (default 2), id?: integer}

test_hydro.desc: Runs the up/down/neutral test of an input event and detects logged errors. Asynchronous: call again after ~2 s.

returns.desc: JSON {event, vid, ok, errors} from the previous test, or start message.
true if the vehicle does not exist.

run_lua_vehicle.desc: Runs Lua in a vehicle's VM (or all of them with all=true); asynchronous results.

returns.desc: JSON of the previous results or "queued" message.
